checks.command: pnpm --dir services/dsh test && node --test services/dsh/tests/*field*.test.mjs && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run typecheck
checks.proves: Field escalation/offline shared/backend targeted checks pass.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove process death, radio loss timing or operator-device convergence.
checks.passCriteria: Commands exit zero with queue lifecycle, retry classification, revocation and reconciliation tests included.
checks.failCriteria: Any duplicate/retry/scope/queue migration/targeted test failure or missing required test fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: create field escalation then operator request/resolve and field refresh; queue supported mutations offline; kill/restart app; lose network before and after server commit; revoke assignment while offline; reconnect; inspect operation references and required partner/operator readback.
checks.proves: Real lifecycle/recovery does not lose or duplicate field work and respects current authorization.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not cover unrelated app offline systems or production telemetry.
checks.passCriteria: Every operation reaches an explainable final/pending state, committed effects occur once, revoked work is rejected and escalation decisions converge.
checks.failCriteria: False success, duplicate effect, infinite retry of permanent error, unauthorized replay, lost evidence or stale readback fails.
